title: RFID card enrollment
description: Which Attractap readers may enroll and reset RFID cards. A new card key is written through the reader, so allow only readers in a place you trust.

mode.label: Enroll and reset RFID cards on
mode.description: Readers that are not allowed here still let members sign in with their cards.

all.label: All readers
all.description: Every reader with firmware 2.0.0 or later can enroll and reset RFID cards.

selected.label: Selected readers
selected.description: Only the readers you pick below can enroll and reset RFID cards.

secured.label: Only secured readers
secured.description: Only readers that are currently secured can enroll and reset RFID cards. A reader that loses its Secured status cannot write cards until it is secured again.

readers.label: Allowed readers
readers.description: Pick the readers that may enroll and reset RFID cards.
readers.none: There are no paired readers yet. Pair readers on the Attractap Readers page under "Not paired".
readers.required: Select at least one reader, or choose all readers.

blockers.firmwareUpdateRequired: Cannot write cards until it runs firmware 2.0.0 or later.
blockers.noCardEnrollment: This reader model cannot enroll or reset cards.

uidOnly.label: Allow UID-only cards (insecure)
uidOnly.description: Cheap RFID cards (MIFARE Classic, MIFARE Ultralight, NTAG213/215/216, DESFire EV1) only offer a UID and no encryption. Off by default. This switch applies immediately; it is not saved with the reader settings above.
uidOnly.warning: UID-only cards can be copied with cheap tools. Anyone who reads such a card can impersonate its owner on machines and doors. Cards with AES (NTAG 424 DNA, DESFire EV2/EV3) are never affected and always need their key.
uidOnly.offNote: While this is off, existing UID-only cards stop working on all readers and plugins until it is turned on again. They stay in the card lists.

confirm.title: Allow UID-only cards?
confirm.message: UID-only cards can be copied with cheap tools. Anyone who reads such a card can impersonate its owner on machines and doors, including doors opened through plugins. Only turn this on if you accept this risk. Each change is recorded in the audit log.
